ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 70% high-intensity white/grey pixels occupying the central and lateral lobe areas, and 30% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the peduncle base and trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central white field is bifurcated by a dark vertical peduncle column. Symmetrical low-intensity linear clusters (rake marks) are mapped to the upper lateral quadrants of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees, extending downward toward the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by peaks ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in height relative to the adjacent valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a sharp upward taper at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, circular barnacle structures (Coronula diadema) visible at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Minor dark punctate spots scattered across the central white surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant series of roughly parallel, low-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) spanning the lateral margins of both lobes, oriented vertically toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks consistent with interspecific interaction; barnacle colonization on lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Water droplet occlusion and spray artifacts visible at the bottom-center of the fluke, partially masking the lower peduncle-to-lobe transition.
